assumptions.statement: The repository provisional Overall Design Area and three key-area polygons are used only as temporary constraints. Their submitted coordinates exactly match PROV-SITE-001 and PROV-KEY-001/002/003 in the frozen repository source at ce2c6bcee.
assumptions.impact: Every geometry-derived area, ratio, drawing and location must be regenerated when official polygons arrive.

assumptions.statement: Regulatory controls, road redlines, ownership/cadastral parcels, official rail and water/blue lines, utilities, fire access, heritage and engineering constraints remain unavailable as citable official or cleared geometry. geometry/constraints.geojson therefore stays an explicit empty set instead of duplicating provisional scope polygons or inventing controls.
assumptions.impact: Land-use partitions, rooms, crossings and phasing are conceptual recommendations rather than statutory or engineering conclusions. Add a constraint feature only after its publisher, version, date, coordinate system, license/reuse terms and transformation are recorded, then regenerate the whole package.

assumptions.statement: An official 2025 participation notice proves the draft consultation process, while a 2026 Beijing Daily report republished by People.cn reports approval and selected text facts for a 2024-2035 plan. The official approval document, complete plan text, statutory drawings and rights-cleared vector geometry have not been retrieved; the 2022-2035 draft label and 2024-2035 reported-approved label therefore remain separately attributed rather than silently reconciled.
assumptions.impact: Planning signals may qualify the narrative and prioritise the heritage-park line, Dazhongsi focus, walking/cycling continuity and survey-first reuse. They cannot modify geometry, metrics, statutory controls, real-building decisions, approval claims, government endorsement or implementation commitments.

assumptions.statement: Six small footprints test reversible rooms or adaptive reuse; they are not surveyed existing buildings or approved envelopes.
assumptions.impact: Retain–renovate–demolish choices, height, FAR, structure and exact siting remain unknown.

assumptions.statement: Data Co-op means a cooperative governance prototype, not a registered cooperative, statutory data exchange, ownership declaration or confirmed public body.
assumptions.impact: Data-processing roles, contracts, voting, remuneration, fiduciary duties and applicable law require specialist confirmation.

assumptions.statement: Demonstrations use synthetic, official open, or explicitly rights-cleared data; no private resident dataset is required to prove the concept.
assumptions.impact: No scenario may default to surveillance or condition a basic service on data contribution.

assumptions.statement: Withdrawal from a derivative chain does not guarantee perfect erasure from every previously trained model or lawful research output.
assumptions.impact: Receipts must report delete, isolate, stop-use, retrain/unlearn, suspend or retire actions and disclose residual effects.

assumptions.statement: Public return is a proposed licence condition with a named beneficiary group, due date and human acceptance record; no funding or dividend is promised.
assumptions.impact: Failure to evidence the agreed return blocks proposed renewal but does not assert a current legal sanction.

assumptions.statement: DAZHONGSI-MVP-01 is a reversible rehearsal fit inside the provisional PROV-KEY-003 polygon. Its rooms, public space, scenario points and route segments are not surveyed facilities, station entrances, road rights, property commitments or approved works.
assumptions.impact: Before any field use, confirm official boundary, transport barriers and entrances, ownership, heritage, utilities, fire safety, accessibility and operating roles; then relocate the fit, regenerate every affected carrier and repeat the rehearsal.

assumptions.statement: International cases are first-party background references from different legal and institutional contexts.
assumptions.impact: They inform mechanisms but do not prove Chinese project legality, effectiveness, partnerships or implementation.

assumptions.statement: DAZHONGSI-DRILL-01 is a synthetic drill and failure-test suite over the DAZHONGSI-FIELD-OPS-01 template contract. All fixtures are synthetic or paper inputs; field values in the template remain null / unknown / not_observed / not_signed.
assumptions.impact: Passing proves reproducible contract logic only. It must not be cited as field observation, site access, permission, entity confirmation, risk clearance, or operating commitment; official or field evidence still triggers full recalculation.
